# Fitness Made Simple SG

> 1-on-1 personal training in Singapore for busy professionals and complete beginners. In-person coaching in the East and CBD, plus online coaching. No cookie-cutter programs, no gym intimidation.

Fitness Made Simple SG is an independent personal training business run by a single coach with 10+ years of hands-on training experience, currently completing NCSF certification (expected October 2026). Training is available in-person in Singapore (East and CBD) or online with async check-ins.

## Pricing
- East (in-person): $100/session
- CBD (in-person): $150/session
- Online coaching: $200/month

## Pages
- [Home](https://fitnessmadesimplesg.netlify.app/): overview, pricing, and contact form
- [FAQ](https://fitnessmadesimplesg.netlify.app/faq): answers to common questions about training, experience level, injuries, and how sessions work
- [Blog](https://fitnessmadesimplesg.netlify.app/blog/): notes on training and coaching
